label: It is impossible that there be no first efficient cause: something that…, by Well-founded-reductio
meaning: Suppose there is no first efficient cause. By well-founded induction on the per se series: a caused thing has a cause other than itself; that cause, if caused by nothing, would be first; so it is caused, hence a middle cause one step up the series, which cannot continue forever. So nothing is caused, contradicting the observed order of causes.
